items.summary: Preprint proposing a sparse variant of LoRA fine-tuning meant to make the resulting circuits easier to trace inside a model.
items.whyItMatters: Useful if you audit fine-tuned models and want adapters you can inspect.

items.summary: Preprint on a unified vision-language world model that adapts how many reasoning streams it runs, from a Stanford-linked author group.
items.whyItMatters: A look at where multimodal world models are heading; no code claim visible.

items.summary: Preprint testing whether language models can tell tampered machine learning papers from sound ones.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant if you use LLMs to screen or review research.

items.summary: Preprint arguing that attention head dimension affects how well language models retrieve information from long contexts.
items.whyItMatters: Worth a read if you pick architectures for long-context retrieval.

items.summary: Benchmark preprint for agents that must keep spatiotemporal memory over long horizons, paired with a harness for agent testing.
items.whyItMatters: A new yardstick for agent memory; check whether the data is released.

items.summary: Preprint mapping where in a vision-language model's layers safety behavior sits and how refusal can be steered in both directions.
items.whyItMatters: Shows safety behavior can be localized, which cuts both ways for defenders.

items.summary: Preprint on a data-free way for a language model to improve itself through on-policy training, with Google-affiliated authors.
items.whyItMatters: If it holds up, cheaper post-training without curated data.

items.summary: Preprint combining DINO features with image structure to discover object parts.
items.whyItMatters: Niche vision result; skim only if you do part segmentation.

items.summary: Preprint on reading a model's internal representations early to analyze and steer its chain-of-thought trajectories.
items.whyItMatters: May help detect reasoning that goes off track before it finishes.

items.summary: Preprint on a model that reasons and responds at the same time while watching streaming video proactively.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant to live video assistants; early research stage.

items.summary: Preprint on merging vision datasets across tasks and annotating them semi-automatically.
items.whyItMatters: Niche data-prep method for vision teams.

items.summary: Preprint on a vision-language model aimed at decision-making in histopathology.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow clinical imaging work; far from deployment.

items.summary: Preprint quantifying how strongly reasoning models follow hints placed in their prompts.
items.whyItMatters: A measure of prompt-hint sensitivity that bears on trusting model reasoning.

items.summary: Preprint on why agreement, not normalisation, keeps added depth useful in looped language models.
items.whyItMatters: Architecture detail for those studying weight-shared transformers.

items.summary: Preprint scaling transformer-based energy models to high-quality image synthesis, with Yilun Du among the authors.
items.whyItMatters: An alternative to diffusion worth tracking if results replicate.

items.summary: Preprint on how well paper acceptance can be predicted.
items.whyItMatters: Of interest to authors and reviewers; limited practical use.

items.summary: Preprint on a training-free speedup for decoding overlapping tiles in vision transformers.
items.whyItMatters: Could cut inference cost for tiled image pipelines.

items.summary: Preprint benchmarking beet-root detection models on edge devices.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow agricultural case; a useful edge deployment reference.

items.summary: Preprint adapting vision transformers to data stored in Fourier space.
items.whyItMatters: Matters mainly to imaging scientists.

items.summary: Single-author preprint on predictor width in masked latent prediction.
items.whyItMatters: Theory-leaning; of limited use for practitioners.

items.summary: Survey-style preprint covering the mathematics and algorithms behind aligning language models with human feedback.
items.whyItMatters: A reference text for anyone implementing RLHF-style training.

items.summary: Preprint showing ways to make LLM safety guard models judge the wrong text.
items.whyItMatters: If you rely on a guard model, test it against this kind of attack.

items.summary: Preprint proposing a nonlinear approach to erasing and steering concepts in model representations.
items.whyItMatters: Relevant to bias removal and controlled generation work.

items.summary: Audit of label and data quality problems in the RVL-CDIP document dataset.
items.whyItMatters: Check benchmark numbers on this dataset with care.

items.summary: Preprint on pretraining models on Raman spectra from several domains with physics-aware objectives.
items.whyItMatters: Niche scientific use.

items.summary: Preprint on data augmentation choices for DINO in glaucoma classification.
items.whyItMatters: Narrow medical imaging study.

items.summary: Preprint on a lane-keeping control framework for vehicles using only vision.
items.whyItMatters: Control-engineering paper with little LLM relevance.

items.summary: Preprint on controlling several subjects continuously and locally when editing images.
items.whyItMatters: Incremental gain for image editing tools.

items.summary: Preprint on real-time rectification of wide-angle video using learned spatiotemporal cues.
items.whyItMatters: Applies to camera pipelines; narrow.

items.summary: Preprint using an agentic pipeline to turn robot demonstrations into interactive simulated worlds.
items.whyItMatters: Could ease building robot training environments from real footage.
